semiconductor_relevance: Low — dataLobster focuses on AI and IoT solutions for industrial equipment monitoring, which does not directly relate to semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: dataLobster develops AI and IoT solutions aimed at real-time equipment monitoring and anomaly detection for industrial machinery. Their plug-and-play devices track performance, quality, and energy consumption, providing insights to improve operational efficiency.

regional_presence.France: Founded in Paris, dataLobster operates within the European market.
